title: Animated Tanks Pack
notes: Only approved-site hit that qualifies. Page states 'This pack contains 4 different animated tank models! All in .FBX, .OBJ and .Blend formats'. NO glTF and NO GLB offered at all - the Doer inherits FBX2glTF configured in Godot, or Blender installed plus Godot's Blender import path. Page carries an 'Animated' checkmark but names no clips, states no rig, and says nothing about node structure: separate hull/turret/barrel is PLAUSIBLE (a tank animation usually needs a rotating turret and moving tracks) but is NOT stated anywhere on the page - treat as unconfirmed. 'Textured' is marked with an X, i.e. untextured flat-material low-poly, which suits a neon-on-dark emissive look. Pack of 4 tanks, so downloading it means taking three tanks you do not need, plus all three formats side by side. Created June 2019. Thumbnail URL fetched separately and returned HTTP 200 image/jpeg.

title: Tank (by Quaternius)
notes: OFF-LIST SITE (poly.pizza is in `candidates`, not `approved`). Re-host that credits Quaternius; page states 'Public Domain (CC0)' linking creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. Offers 'FBX/GLTF format' - the page does NOT distinguish .glb from .gltf+.bin+loose textures, so plan for the worse case. Value over the quaternius.com pack above is format and size: glTF is available here and the model downloads ALONE rather than as a four-tank, three-format pack. Tagged 'Low Poly', 'Transport', 'Animated', '#Tank', '#Armored'; published 26 Aug 2021. No triangle count shown, no description text, NOTHING stated about node structure or whether hull/turret/barrel are separate objects - unconfirmed. Poly Pizza lists six separate 'Tank' entries by Quaternius (/m/FA5daiyZQq, /m/cW3zvvkMOM, /m/Dc4k4CooN3, /m/jWS1CLA0RO, /m/uYHpj7lz1J, /m/j59k7ctnZM); three of those were fetched and all read the same CC0 + FBX/GLTF, so any of them is a live alternative.

title: Heavy Tank [extra low poly, RTS]
notes: OFF-LIST SITE (opengameart.org, licence is per-submission and this one reads CC0). The ONLY candidate here that names .glb - page tags are 'tank, heavy vehicle, rts, command and conquer, tiberian sun, .blend, glb' and the single attachment is heavy_tank00.zip containing .blend and .glb. Author 32kda, posted 14 June 2026. Page states '792 vers, ~1100 faces' - that is vertices and FACES, not triangles, so tri_count is left null rather than doubled by guesswork. Description: 'Inspired by C&C/Tiberain Sun/Generals game series ... UV-unwrapped but textured in 3 different colors only'. Chunky RTS silhouette, reads well at distance, which is the requested style. NOTHING on the page indicates whether the turret is a separate object - unconfirmed, and that is the risk on the top format pick.

title: Recon Tank
licence: CC-BY 4.0 and CC0 (both listed on the page)
notes: OFF-LIST SITE (opengameart.org). Licence field lists TWO licences, CC-BY 4.0 and CC0, side by side - reported verbatim, not interpreted. STRONGEST structural evidence in this shortlist: the description states '970 tris 962 verts 15 objects', so the model is explicitly built from 15 separate objects rather than one fused mesh - though the page does not name them, so which object is the turret is still unconfirmed. Worst format tier of the five: .obj (reconTank.obj) and .blend (reconTank.blend) only, no glTF. The .blend is the one that preserves those 15 objects as separate nodes via Godot's Blender import path; .obj collapses to surfaces, not nodes. Author MNDV.ecb (eric buisson, 2018). 'no textures, yet.' It is a WHEELED recon tank, not tracked. Author notes the model 'should be rotated properly for y-up engines but i haven't tested'.

title: Low poly tank assets
notes: OFF-LIST SITE (opengameart.org). Licence reads CC0, 'no need to credit'. Author danitorres567, made in Blender 2.79. Weakest of the five and listed as a fallback: no glTF or GLB in the format list, no poly counts, and NOTHING stated about node structure or separate turret/hull - unconfirmed. Single 14.6 MB attachment low_poly_tanks.zip that bundles far more than the models: '4 tanks with different colors' plus missile ammo, a full battle stage, life bars and a game title graphic, in five formats side by side. So this is a large download to extract one tank from.
